req.title: Reject empty firstName
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when the Player payload contains an empty firstName.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-022 requires HTTP 422 when firstName is empty string. We need: (1) a positive test confirming a valid non-empty firstName yields 201, (2) a negative test confirming empty string firstName yields 422, (3) a boundary test confirming a single-character firstName (length=1, the minimum non-empty value) yields 201, and (4) additional boundary/decision-table tests for whitespace-only and null firstName to maximize mutation kill rate. The Pydantic model declares first_name: str (non-optional), so empty string passes type validation but the requirement mandates 422. We assert exact status codes (not ranges) to catch comparison-operator mutations.

tests.name: test_post_player_valid_firstname_returns_201
preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
Squad number 99 is not present in the pre-loaded dataset
actions: POST /players/ with a fully valid payload where firstName is a non-empty string
expected: Response body contains firstName matching the submitted value
Response body contains squadNumber matching the submitted value
trace: R-PLAYER-022: valid firstName must be accepted (positive EP partition)
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_valid_firstname_returns_201():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Lionel",
        "lastName": "Messi",
        "squadNumber": 99,
        "position": "Forward"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["firstName"] == "Lionel"
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 99
    assert body["lastName"] == "Messi"

from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_empty_firstname_response_body_has_detail():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "",
        "lastName": "Test",
        "squadNumber": 95,
        "position": "Midfielder"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 422
    body = r.json()
    assert "detail" in body
    assert isinstance(body["detail"], list)
    assert len(body["detail"]) >= 1
